{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the total number of patients and severe cases
total_patients = len(trial_df)
severe_patients = trial_df[trial_df['severity'] == 'severe'].shape[0]

# Check for any missing values in severity
missing_severity = trial_df['severity'].isnull().sum()

# Output the counts and missing values
total_patients, severe_patients, missing_severity"}
